blocks.text: Branch Connector groups represent a cluster of individual Branch Connectors used to configure policy rules in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Branch Connector groups provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Apply policies to a group of Branch Connectors.
Upgrade Branch Connectors belonging to a group to maintain redundancy while upgrades are being run.

blocks.text: You can create Branch Connector groups in the Zscaler Admin Console using the images shared with your hypervisor. To learn more, see Downloading Branch Connector Images and About Branch Connector Groups.

blocks.heading: About the Branch Connector Groups Page

blocks.text: On the Branch Connector Groups page (Private Access > Private Infrastructure > Branch Connector Groups), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the Branch Connector group information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Refresh the Branch Connector Groups page to reflect the most current information.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.

View a list of all deployed Branch Connector groups. Click the Branch Connector group name to open the Branch Connector Group Details drawer where you can see additional details about the Branch Connector group.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
